card.title: Port smart battery housing
card.what: One of two identical sealed housings, each with its own BMS board and microcontroller board. Plugs into the hull with a power SubConn and a telemetry SubConn.
rows: MaxAmps LiPo, 8000 mAh, 5S2P (5 in series, 2 in parallel)
18.5 V nominal; 16 V empty, about 20.75 V charged
BQ40Z80 gas gauge and protector; 45 A self-control fuse; output off below 3.2 V per cell
J3 PORT BATTERY (Anderson PP45 2x2): VPORT, GND

card.title: Starboard smart battery housing
card.what: Same design as the port housing. A side-detect pin, read through the BMS at boot, makes it client 2 (port is 1); the firmware has a TODO to confirm the pin matches the side on the vehicle.
rows: MaxAmps LiPo, 8000 mAh, 5S2P (5 in series, 2 in parallel)
18.5 V nominal; 16 V empty, about 20.75 V charged
BQ40Z80 gas gauge and protector; 45 A self-control fuse; output off below 3.2 V per cell
J4 STBD BATTERY (Anderson PP45 2x2): VSTBD, GND

card.title: Physical kill switch
card.what: The handle on the port tube's bow window (CAD "Kill Switch Knuckles"). A Hall-effect sensor on the board stack's fan block senses the magnet in the handle through the window (2024 design report). Handle off: thruster power is cut in hardware, whatever the software does.
rows: Handle outside the port bow window; sensor inside, on the fan block
J1 KILL / AUX (Molex Mini-Fit Jr 4-pin): GND, GND, KILL_SWITCH, AUX_SWITCH
the AUX switch, read as state/aux

card.title: Battery OR ("balancer")
card.what: 2 x LTC4412 + 4 x SiR167DP. Whichever battery is higher supplies V+; STAT pins report which are supplying. Reverse current from one pack into the other is blocked.
rows: Port tube, on the POAC (the bottom board of the stack)
2 x LTC4412 controllers, 4 x SiR167DP P-channel MOSFETs
state/electrical port_powering, stbd_powering; state/batteries_balanced when both supply

card.title: Kill MOSFETs
card.what: The thruster power switch. Three P-channel MOSFETs in parallel connect V+ to MOTOR_PWR, the ESC supply. They conduct only while MOTOR_EN is on: the physical switch is in AND the microcontroller holds SOFTWARE_KILL at "run".
rows: Port tube, on the POAC (the bottom board of the stack)
3 x SiR167DP (30 V, 60 A each), 3 x TC4432 gate drivers, DG448 analog switch
J7, J8 ESC PWR (Redcube M4 85 A terminal): MOTOR_PWR (switched by the kill circuit)
J9, J10 ESC GND (Redcube M4 85 A terminal): GND

card.title: POAC RP2040
card.what: Runs the kill-switch logic (the software kill slots), measures the rails with a 16-bit ADC and drives the actuator servo. It reports as the "power board" on CAN, client 1.
rows: Port tube, on the POAC (the bottom board of the stack)
on the internal bus (can0, classic CAN, 1 Mbit/s), client 1

card.title: Schottky diode (MBRB2545CT)
card.what: Sits between V+ and both regulator modules. Its output is Vreg, which feeds the 15 V and 5 V modules. The 2024 report says it is there "to prevent back-flow current".
rows: Port tube, on the POAC (the bottom board of the stack)
Vreg, into PS1 (15 V) and PS2 (5 V)
state/electrical balanced_voltage reads Vreg, after the diode

card.title: 15 V regulator
card.what: TDK-Lambda i6A4W020A033V non-isolated DC-DC module (9-53 V in, 20 A), trimmed to 15 V. Fed from Vreg, which is V+ through a Schottky diode.
rows: Port tube, on the POAC (the bottom board of the stack)
camera cage board (Orin, DVL, Peltier output if fitted), stack link, 12 V LDO
state/electrical twelve_volt_voltage (the name is historical); expect 14.7-16.0 V

card.title: 5 V regulator
card.what: The same TDK-Lambda module, trimmed to 5 V. Each board in the stack and the camera cage makes its own 3.3 V from this with an LM1117 LDO.
rows: Port tube, on the POAC (the bottom board of the stack)
board logic (POAC microcontroller, stack link, camera cage), network switch, fans, depth sensor, LED strip

card.title: 12 V regulator
card.what: MIC29300-12, a 3 A linear regulator from the 15 V rail. It feeds the servo connector on the lid: the launcher servo, and the claw servo if it shares that bus (unconfirmed). Not measured by the ADC.
rows: Port tube, on the POAC (the bottom board of the stack)
LID_CONN1 LID_CONN (Molex Mini-Fit Jr 4-pin): GND, 12V, ACT_PWM_5V (servo data), ACT_CHECK_5V

card.title: ESC board 0 (thrusters 0-3)
card.what: Carrier for four ESCs. Solder jumper SB1 left open makes it board 0, CAN client 2.
rows: Port tube, in the board stack
MOTOR_PWR on Redcube terminals "ESC V+" / "ESC GND"
reverse-voltage MOSFETs, 60 A board fuse, one 15 A fuse per ESC
5 V on the ESC stack link (where the cable comes from is not in the designs)
J5 Thruster SubConn (Molex Mini-Fit Jr 12-pin): 3 motor phases x 4 ESCs
on the internal bus (can0, classic CAN, 1 Mbit/s), client 2

card.title: ESC board 1 (thrusters 4-7)
card.what: The same board with SB1 bridged, so it reads as board 1, CAN client 3.
rows: Port tube, in the board stack
MOTOR_PWR on Redcube terminals "ESC V+" / "ESC GND"
reverse-voltage MOSFETs, 60 A board fuse, one 15 A fuse per ESC
5 V on the ESC stack link (where the cable comes from is not in the designs)
J5 Thruster SubConn (Molex Mini-Fit Jr 12-pin): 3 motor phases x 4 ESCs
on the internal bus (can0, classic CAN, 1 Mbit/s), client 3

card.title: Thrusters 0-3
card.what: Blue Robotics T200s, three motor phases each, through the lid SubConns. The ESCs drive them with bidirectional DShot600 and report RPM back.
rows: about 7 A forward, 10 A reverse at Talos's 24 N limit (T200 data, 18 V)

card.title: Thrusters 4-7
card.what: The other four T200s, on ESC board 1.
rows: about 7 A forward, 10 A reverse at 24 N (T200 data, 18 V)

card.title: LED board
card.what: Two ST L99LD20 buck LED drivers run straight from V+ and feed an aluminium RGBW LED module. Logic runs from 5 V.
rows: Port tube, in the board stack
J2 stack link (Mini-Fit Jr 6-pin): CANL, GND, V+, CANH, 5V
J1 LED module (Samtec LS2 10-pin): R/G/B/W anodes, GND, Temp_Sense (NTC), Conn CHK
on the internal bus (can0, classic CAN, 1 Mbit/s), client 6

card.title: IVC board (acoustic modem)
card.what: Talks to Triton (the team's second vehicle) with 17/19 kHz tones: it sends through the transducer and listens with the hydrophone, which also hears the competition pinger. The transmit amplifier runs on an isolated +/-24 V converter from V+ (1.5 A fuse); the receive chain on an isolated +/-5 V converter from 5 V.
rows: Port tube, in the board stack
J2 STACK LINK (Mini-Fit Jr 6-pin): CAN, GND, V+, 5V
J1 ACOUSTICS INTERCONNECT (Mini-Fit Jr 4-pin): TransducerOut, HydrophoneIn, GND
on the internal bus (can0, classic CAN, 1 Mbit/s), client 8

card.title: IVC receive chain
card.what: The listening half of the IVC board: the hydrophone's signal is amplified and filtered on an isolated +/-5 V supply, made from the 5 V rail, so the small analog signal stays off the ground the motors share.
rows: Port tube, in the board stack
J1 ACOUSTICS INTERCONNECT: HydrophoneIn (J5 is a backup input)

card.title: Hydrophone (Aquarian H1C)
card.what: An underwater microphone. It hears the competition pinger and the IVC tones from Triton, and feeds the IVC board's receive chain. It sits in a pod low at the stern, starboard side (CAD).
rows: Outside the hull, low at the stern (starboard)
J1 ACOUSTICS INTERCONNECT: HydrophoneIn, GND (J5 is a backup hydrophone input with +/-5 V)

card.title: IVC transducer
card.what: The underwater speaker the IVC board transmits through, driven by its OPA548 amplifier on +/-24 V. A separate part low at the stern, port side (CAD); boards.html: a transducer the team built.
rows: Outside the hull, low at the stern (port)

card.title: Torpedo and marker launcher servo
card.what: One servo in an aluminium housing releases both torpedoes and both markers. The firmware drives a Hiwonder-protocol bus servo: 12 V plus a half-duplex serial line at 115200 baud, level-shifted to 5 V. The CAD shows an SER-20XX; which servo is fitted today is unconfirmed.
rows: Outside the hull, under the vehicle
LID_CONN1 LID_CONN (Molex Mini-Fit Jr 4-pin): GND, 12V, ACT_PWM_5V (servo data), ACT_CHECK_5V

card.title: Claw servo
card.what: The claw under the bow has its own servo. The unmerged poac-multiple-servos firmware drives it as bus servo ID 3 on the launcher's serial line, so it would share LID_CONN1 and its 12 V. Which firmware and wiring are on Talos today is unconfirmed.
rows: Outside the hull, under the bow

card.title: Camera cage breakout board
card.what: Takes 15 V, 5 V and the internal CAN bus from the POAC and hands them out inside the camera cage. Switches the Orin and a Peltier output (15 V, if one is fitted) and four fans (5 V); reads the depth sensor.
rows: Starboard tube, in the camera cage
J6 CAM CAGE (from POAC) (Mini-Fit Jr 8-pin): internal CAN, 5V, 15V
J17 ORIN (Mini-Fit Jr 4-pin): switched 15 V Orin power
J10 ORIN CAN (JST XH 5-pin): external CAN H/L, GND, internal CAN H/L (to the Orin)
RGB status strip (J9), external CAN + 15 V (J1/J5), extra power (J11)
on the internal bus (can0, classic CAN, 1 Mbit/s), client 4

card.title: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin
card.what: The main computer. Its 15 V comes through an FDD4141 switch on the camera cage board, on at boot. command/electrical CYCLE_COMPUTER turns it off for 5 s and back on.
rows: Starboard tube, in the camera cage
J17 ORIN (Mini-Fit Jr 4-pin): switched 15 V Orin power
Ethernet to the switch, GMSL2 to the cameras, CAN and serial through its HAT and M.2 card

card.title: Jetson AGX breakout ("Orin HAT")
card.what: Plugs onto the Orin's 40-pin header: two CAN transceivers (can0 internal, can1 external) and an RS-232 transceiver for the IMU, which it also powers (5 V).
rows: Starboard tube, in the camera cage
J1 CAN (JST XH 5-pin): can1 H/L, GND, can0 H/L
J2 IMU (JST XH 4-pin): 5V, RS-232 TX/RX, GND
the 2026 report shows an "Orin HAT"; that it is this electric_boogaloo design (Jetson AGX Breakout) is inferred

card.title: VectorNav VN-100 IMU
card.what: Serial over RS-232 through the HAT, /dev/ttyTHS0 on the Orin. Powered with 5 V from the HAT.
rows: Starboard tube, in the camera cage

card.title: Jetson M.2 RS-422 card ("FOG board")
card.what: An M.2 card in the Orin. It makes the gyro's supply (boost to 8 V, then a 5 V LDO) and converts RS-422.
rows: Starboard tube: an M.2 card in the Orin
the 2026 report shows a "FOG board"; that it is this M.2 RS-422 design is inferred (a 2024 commit calls it the FOG board)

card.title: Fizoptika fibre-optic gyro
card.what: Yaw rate. Power and RS-422 from the FOG board; the 2025 design report describes the pogo-pin mount that replaced its fragile pin connector.

card.title: Forward camera (ffc)
card.what: A Stereolabs ZED X Mini (camera_model zedxm) looking out of the starboard bow window, on the Orin's GMSL2 capture card.
rows: Starboard tube, in the camera cage
GMSL2 capture card on the Orin

card.title: Downward camera (dfc)
card.what: A second ZED X Mini, under the starboard tube looking down (CAD "DFC Mount"). It connects to the camera cage through a quick-connect slide-in adapter (2025 design report) and on to the GMSL2 card.
rows: Under the starboard tube, outside the cage
GMSL2 capture card on the Orin

card.title: Ethernet switch
card.what: Joins the Orin, the DVL and the tether on one wired network (192.168.1.0/24). Powered with 5 V from the camera cage board. Model not in the designs.
rows: J16 SWITCH (Mini-Fit Jr 2-pin): 5V for the network switch ("Network Switch Power")
J13 DVL | SWITCH (RJ45 (Wurth WR-MJ)): the same Ethernet pairs, on to the network switch (no power)

card.title: Nortek DVL1000
card.what: One cable carries both: the camera cage board injects 15 V and ground on two spare pins of the DVL's Ethernet cable, and passes the data pairs on to the switch.
rows: Outside the hull, under the middle of the vehicle
J14 DVL SUBCONN (RJ45 (Wurth WR-MJ)): DVL Ethernet pairs + 15V/GND on pins 7-8 ("Ethernet Power Injection")

card.title: Blue Robotics Bar02 depth sensor
card.what: MS5837-02BA pressure sensor read over I2C by the camera cage board, which publishes state/depth/raw.
rows: J15 depth sensor (JST GH 4-pin): 5V, SCL, SDA, GND

card.title: Cooling fans
card.what: Up to four cage fans on the camera cage board and one board-stack fan on the POAC, all 5 V and switched by MOSFETs, on at boot. command/electrical ENABLE_FANS / DISABLE_FANS.
rows: J2, J4, J7, J8 (FAN 1-4), with tachometers
J11 FAN (JST XH 3-pin): FAN_TACH, FAN_PWR, GND
how many fans and whether the Peltier cooler (J3, 15 V) are fitted today

card.title: Ethernet tether
card.what: Through a lid SubConn to the surface router. Off for competition runs; then the physical switch is the only kill.
